title: Objectwise derived evaluation detects comparison direct-image vanishing
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme and $\Lambda$ a discrete associative unital ring, not necessarily commutative [def-pc-scheme]. Use the small étale and pro-étale sites in a common larger universe in which they are small [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Use sheaves of left modules over the associated constant ring sheaves [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $
u_X:X_{\mathrm{proét}}	o X_{\mathrm{ét}}$ be the comparison geometric morphism [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]; its module direct image $
u_{X,*}$ is restriction to the étale objects with their induced scalar actions. Let $M$ be any such module sheaf on $X_{\mathrm{proét}}$ and $q>0$ an integer. For each étale $W	o X$, let $\Gamma_{\mathrm{proét},W}$ be evaluation $N\mapsto N(W)$ to abelian groups. Right derived functors here are computed by injective resolutions in the respective module categories [def-sp-left-exact-additive, def-sp-injective-resolutions]. If
$$ R^q\Gamma_{\mathrm{proét},W}(M)=0\quad	ext{for every étale }W	o X, $$
then $R^q
u_{X,*}M=0$ as a module sheaf on $X_{\mathrm{ét}}$. No assumption that $M$ is an inverse image or injective is made.

proof.text: Specialize [lem-sfb-proetale-sheaves-grothendieck] to the Grothendieck abelian coefficient category ModuleCat Λ (Mathlib.Algebra.Category.ModuleCat.AB). The existing pro-etale sheaf instance and [lem-sp-grothendieck-enough-injectives] supply enough injectives and hence an injective resolution I of M. This uses the fixed-scalar encoding already present in the statement, without constructing or transporting a category of modules over a varying ring sheaf.

source.place: Tag 079Q (remark-existence-D), with derived.tex Tag 013K (lemma-injective-resolutions-exist), proof of (1)

proof.text: Put $J^\bullet=\nu_{X,*}I^\bullet$. By the injective-resolution definition [def-sp-left-exact-additive], $R^q\nu_{X,*}M=\mathcal H^q(J^\bullet)$, and the same resolution computes $R^q\Gamma_{\mathrm{proét},W}(M)=H^q(I^\bullet(W))$ for each étale $W\to X$. Direct image in the statement is restriction, including on module morphisms; hence $J^n(W)=I^n(W)$ and the differentials agree. Thus the hypothesis says exactly $H^q(J^\bullet(W))=0$ as an abelian group for every such $W$.

source.place: Tag 099V (lemma-relative-comparison), first paragraph; injective-resolution interpretation expanded from the definition

proof.text: Let S be the short complex at degree q of J. Apply the faithful forgetful functor from etale sheaves to presheaves. By CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.exact_iff_evaluation (WeilConjectures.Mathlib.Algebra.Homology.ShortComplex.Exact), it suffices to check exactness at each etale object W. Forget scalars using the faithful additive functor ModuleCat Λ to abelian groups. The short complex obtained this way is definitionally the degree-q short complex of the evaluation of I used in Step 2. Thus its exactness is exactly the vanishing supplied by the hypothesis, via HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff_isZero_homology.

source.place: Tag 03DA (lemma-abelian) and preceding construction of kernels; cycle-boundary calculation for the complex in Tag 099V

proof.text: Apply Mathlib CategoryTheory.Functor.reflects_exact_of_faithful first to forgetting scalars and then to the faithful additive inclusion of module-valued sheaves into presheaves. These are functors between abelian categories, and no assertion that sheaf evaluation preserves cokernels is used. This proves S exact; HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff_isZero_homology identifies this with zero degree-q cohomology of J, and the injective-resolution isomorphism of Step 2 gives the required zero higher direct image.

The statement is true for an arbitrary associative ring Λ and arbitrary M; I checked Λ=0, X empty, M_2(F_p), and that no step assumes a module-injective is abelian-injective. Step 1: the Grothendieck lemma and enough injectives give an injective resolution, and the iterative cokernel construction is correct. Step 2: def-sp-left-exact-additive is a Mathlib-matched definition that includes independence of the resolution. Evaluation and ν_* preserve kernels because module kernels are sectionwise, and étale W is an object of X_proét, so J^n(W)=I^n(W). Advisory: left exactness of ν_* is argued only in the report, but the statement fixes this computation. Step 3: the sectionwise kernel clause gives that p(W) is surjective, and q>0 is used correctly. Step 4: a sectionwise surjection is an epimorphism of sheaves, and H^q=coker(J^{q-1}→Z)=0. This is valid and simpler than the 03F3 sheafification route because the hypothesis holds for every étale W. There is no duplicate: det-pe-injective-acyclicity-reduction is for commutative Λ and affine W, and the other candidates are for scheme morphisms or injective inputs. lean.statement: theorem isZero_rightDerived_comparisonLowerStar_of_evaluation (X : Scheme.{u}) (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [Ring Λ] (M : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (h : ∀ W : X.Etale, IsZero (((sheafToPresheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) ⋙ (evaluation X.ProEtᵒᵖ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj (op ((Scheme.toProEt X).obj W)) ⋙ forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).rightDerived q).obj M)) : IsZero (((comparisonLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) X).rightDerived q).obj M)
lean.note: Fixed-scalar encoding of sheaves over the associated constant ring sheaf, as in the already recorded parent lem-pe-comparison-injective-left-modules-acyclic. Ring Λ, arbitrary M, and derived abelian evaluation in the module category; no injectivity, finiteness, commutativity or inverse-image assumption. The sites retain object universe u+1 and morphism universe u; modules and coefficients lie in the common larger universe u+1. Comparison direct image is the recorded canonical restriction functor, not an arbitrary map.
